services.name: Tuna Fishing
services.desc: Bottom fishing for haddock, cod, pollock, red fish, cusk, and whiting is good all season. We typically do the majority of our bottom fishing between mid-May and end of June which seems to be the prime time however you can catch them year round. There are instances that we can do a little bottom fishing while fishing for other species, for example shark fishing charters. We leave early in the morning for almost all deep sea fishing charters. The bite is best at first light however you can catch fish any time during the day. We bring bait (generally clams) and have artificial jigs and teasers ready as well. services.name: Whale Watch
services.desc: Mass Bay Guides offers the best private whale watching and site seeing trips departing from Scituate, Massachusetts. You can go to Stellwagen Bank and view all types of creatures in the wild, or you can tour Boston Harbor and the beutiful lighthouses and islands. We also offer trips to Historic Plymouth Harbor, where the Pilgrims landed. You can go to Provincetown, MA on the Tip of Cape Cod and get some good deals on some great Native Art or have a nice lunch and dinner. Stellwagen Bank, is most well known for its 19 species of marine mammals. Many of the visitors come to see the seals, dolphins, porpoises and of course, the great whales. Whale watch tours from spring through fall regularly
